acceptance_criteria.criterion: Validation must match the production Source Handling resolver/contract; do not duplicate a weaker or divergent vocabulary if a canonical validator/constant can be reused.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_finding_2_invalid_vocabulary_fails_closed_before_any_write covers five decision families, four disposition families and four Fact dimensions, asserting zero per-Issue state.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A retry after interruption must be recoverable without manual database inspection and without requiring the operator to have captured a timestamp that was printed only after completion.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The fix may make the operation atomic, persist/emit the retry identity before mutation, or deterministically recover it from an exact partial plan — choose the narrowest architecture-compatible solution after inspecting existing transaction/service boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Deterministic exact partial-plan recovery retains the existing independently committed provenance and authority service boundaries without redesign.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Regression must simulate interruption after at least one intermediate provenance write, then invoke a normal retry with no manually supplied `--as-of`; retry must complete successfully and converge to exactly one canonical set of six provenance records + FACT/REGISTRY/POLICY authority heads.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: test_finding_3_interrupted_provisioning_recovery simulates two committed provenance writes, retries without as_of, verifies six provenance records and three revision-one Issue heads, then verifies idempotent retry.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Mismatched partial state must still fail closed; do not silently overwrite or supersede foreign/different content.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Mismatched authority identity, wrong kind, forged/tampered partial records and signed future-known successors fail closed. _check_provenance_heads_exact verifies the complete chain/current head with datetime.max before writes; the successor regression asserts unchanged (2,1,1,0) record/head/authority/authorization counts.

defect_families.evidence: Explicit as_of is bounded before storage initialization. Recovered time comes from authenticated planned provenance. datetime.max is used only for current-head exactness, not live admission; actual issuance and replay cutoffs remain trusted.

Issue document identity and all six provenance identities remain derived from the authorization and exact Issue; content-addressed IDs are unchanged. Head comparisons reject different content.
Canonical validation rejects unknown categories, malformed values, absent or extra operation keys; UNKNOWN_CATEGORY requires exactly four BLOCKED dispositions. Missing authority remains fail closed.

The candidate changes policy validation, not content persistence surfaces. The UNKNOWN_CATEGORY production regression resolves a blocked policy but rejects durable unclassified content; nested-payload controls remain unchanged.
Exact partial recovery reuses authenticated known_at and monotonic admitted provenance. The interrupted retry regression converges to six records and three heads and then returns already-provisioned.
Authorization and publication remain bound to repository-derived Issue scope, exact payload digest, evidence/verifier identities and expected head. No alternate replay or write route is introduced.

Recovery verifies signatures and the chain before trusting known_at; exactness compares the authenticated current head. Forged matching IDs and signed future-known successors have fail-closed regressions.
No connector receipt or ingress policy is changed. This is a clone-capable signed local-push range; authenticated writer provenance and trusted hosted proof remain distinct requirements.

hunter_writer_provenance.py --check-range HEAD passes for the full base-to-head range under Farhad5778/fafa33. Unauthorized Tembo/Jules ancestors were removed by the authorized recovery; new commits are signed.

findings.evidence: Provenance admission lookup was database-wide; it is now restricted to the current Issue's exact six planned identity/kind pairs.
Provisioning could write unsupported policy vocabulary; all Fact and Policy options now pass canonical preflight before any Issue provenance or authority write.
Interrupted no---as-of provisioning could not recover; valid exact partial state now recovers its timestamp and converges, while mismatched state fails closed.
Explicit invalid or future --as-of values previously initialized storage first; temporal validation now precedes repository initialization, with a regression that makes any early initialization fail.

Policies previously accepted invented durable categories. The canonical validator rejects all non-governed categories; the governed UNKNOWN_CATEGORY sentinel is separately constrained to an exact all-BLOCKED fail-closed shape.
Non-string policy and disposition values could raise raw TypeError. Explicit type checks now route malformed values through SourceHandlingBlockedError.
A runtime test fixture used an invented UNUSED_CATEGORY. It now uses the governed payload-unused DIAGNOSTIC category without weakening the production validator.

Recovered provenance was trusted from raw storage before integrity verification. Recovery now discovers only planned pairs and resolves each through the production tamper-verifying provenance resolver before using its timestamp, accepting idempotency, or performing any additional provenance or authority write.

UNKNOWN_CATEGORY was rejected entirely. The governed sentinel is now accepted only with the canonical exact four-operation all-BLOCKED disposition map; invented categories remain rejected and durable persistence remains impossible.

Durable disposition mappings accepted undeclared operation keys. The shared canonical validator now requires exactly PERSIST, READ_ACCESS, RECONSTRUCT, and DELETE_OR_EXPIRE and rejects missing, extra, or malformed keys fail closed.

Current-provenance-head exactness: _check_provenance_heads_exact uses the production signature/chain-verifying resolver with datetime.max, selecting the actual signed head rather than a wall-clock prior version. test_future_known_signed_successor_fails_before_any_provisioning_write proves rejection with unchanged (2,1,1,0) counts.
